system.description: Once per round when you miss an enemy with a heavy melee weapon (but not on a fumble), spend 10 MP to make a (Might + Willpower) check at DL equal to your missed check's result; on success deal (HR + SL) physical damage to that target. You may spend a Fabula Point to use it again in the same round.
